usage.result_excerpt:
I wrote the parser in `main.wj`. It builds, and it gave the right output on a test input that combined the two examples.

That input had an empty line, a lone comma, an escaped-quote field and a quoted field with a comma. I didn't run any other inputs.

It also drops any `\r` outside quotes, so Windows line endings shouldn't add a stray character to the last field.
